title: No hurricane has ever been recorded crossing the equator. I checked 13,635
head: 8,457 storms.
None crossed this line.
tag: Full video: why hurricanes never cross the equator
description: Every tropical storm in NOAA's IBTrACS archive, 1851 to November 2026: 8,457 reached tropical-storm strength, and of 13,635 storm systems none has a recorded position on both sides of the equator. From the full video on Earth Worked Out. #hurricane #science #weather

title: Same low pressure, two latitudes: only one keeps spinning
head: Same dip in the air.
Only one survives.
tag: Full video: why hurricanes never cross the equator
description: A simulation of a layer of air on a spinning planet: the same 600 km dip of low pressure, released at rest. At the equator it spreads out and vanishes; at 15 degrees the Earth's spin holds 14% of it after four days. The textbook formula agrees. From the full video on Earth Worked Out. #hurricane #physics #science

title: The storm that came 78 km from the equator, then turned back
head: 78 km from the equator.
Then it turned back.
tag: Full video: why hurricanes never cross the equator
description: Cyclone Agni, November 2004: the US Joint Typhoon Warning Center track in NOAA IBTrACS puts it at 0.7 degrees north with 35-knot winds, about 78 km from the equator. It turned north and only reached 65 knots as it moved away. From the full video on Earth Worked Out. #cyclone #hurricane #science
